Name: All Bars At Clint's Shop
Author: KaosKuantico
Description:
You can buy any bar at Clint's shop.

Including:
[list]
[*]Cooper Bar
[*]Iron Bar
[*]Gold Bar
[*]Iridium Bar
[*]Radioactive bar
[*]Maple Bar (disabled by default, can be enabled using Generic Mod Config Menu)
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Go to steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/mods
2. Unzip the file inside the Mods folder
3. Done!

[url=https://github.com/KaosKuantico/AllBarsClintShop]Source code in Github[/url]
